description: Reporting hierarchy for scripts/predict.py and scripts/hierarchy_report.py (see evaluation/hierarchy.py). When no subtype reaches the threshold, the summed probability of a family, then of a lineage, is tried. Lineage: the first matching prefix in lineage_by_prefix, unless the class is listed in lineage. Families: a starting proposal from the overlaps seen in the lab's t-SNE of AL_24Sep2026 (HOX-related AML; T-ALL other than TAL1); review them against the cross-validation confusion pairs from scripts/hierarchy_report.py, and fix this file before a locked nanopore set is scored. Names of classes a model does not have are ignored. no_subtype_classes are background classes reported as '<lineage>, no specific subtype'.
